verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes its own rendered OpenAPI reference at api.secureframe.com/docs, with request/response schemas for every endpoint group and the full machine-readable spec embedded. That covers a browsable API reference. Nothing in the evidence shows a try-it console, runnable code samples, or live request execution. Missing for 10: documented runnable/try-it-out examples, evidence of interactive request execution from the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The reference opens every tagged endpoint group with request/response schemas.
Secureframe exposes a REST API for use by customers, partners, and community developers.
the document embeds the full "openapi: 3.0.0 / info: title: Secureframe API" OpenAPI definition that the renderer consumes
